refresh_policy.rationale: Collection reads the activity list that strava.com loads for the owner's own signed-in session. A live session refreshes without a prompt; the first run and an expired session need the owner to sign in through the browser handoff. The first run inventories all activity summaries. Later runs discover new summaries and read at most 100 activity details from a resumable queue. Pages and details are fetched one at a time with pauses.

streams.name: activities
streams.description: Activities read from the owner's signed-in strava.com activity list. The initial inventory emits summaries; later runs can enrich them from activity detail pages, heartrate streams and gear lists. Emitted records exclude routes, GPS coordinates, activity titles and notes.

display.label: Your Strava activities
display.detail: Sport, start time, distance, moving and elapsed time, elevation gain, average and maximum heart rate, calories and gear. No route, no GPS coordinates, no activity titles or notes.

id.description: Strava's numeric activity ID from the signed-in activity list, used as the record's primary key.

activity_type.description: Activity type from the list's type field when present; otherwise derived from sport_type, mapping EMountainBikeRide to EBikeRide, GravelRide and MountainBikeRide to Ride, and TrailRun to Run. Null when neither field has a usable value.

start_date.description: The YYYY-MM-DD date portion of start_time. It uses the local clock when start_time_basis is 'local', otherwise UTC. A UTC date is not necessarily the athlete's local calendar day; use start_date_local for local-day filtering.

start_date_local.description: The athlete's local calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, derived from the activity list's local start value only when it yields a supported, exact UTC offset; otherwise null. This is the consent_time_field. A time_range compares calendar days, and a bounded run excludes activities whose local day is unavailable.

start_time.description: Activity start as an ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset. The browser collector uses a local offset derived from the list's local start value when supported, otherwise UTC (Z). Activities without a usable zoned source start time are not emitted.

start_time_basis.description: The clock used for start_time: 'local' when a supported local offset can be derived from the activity list, otherwise 'utc'. This browser collector does not emit 'unknown'. UTC time does not establish the athlete's local time of day.

distance_m.description: Distance in metres from the activity list's distance_raw field, not its display-unit text. Null when the field is not a finite number.

moving_time_s.description: Moving time in seconds from the activity list's moving_time_raw field. Null when the field is not a finite number.

elapsed_time_s.description: Elapsed time in seconds from the activity list's elapsed_time_raw field. Null when the field is not a finite number.

total_elevation_gain_m.description: Elevation gain in metres from the activity list's elevation_gain_raw field. Null when the field is not a finite number.

average_heartrate.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute, populated from the activity's heartrate stream during detail collection. Summary records carry null; null can also mean no heart-rate data was available.

max_heartrate.description: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute, populated from the activity's heartrate stream during detail collection. Summary records carry null; null can also mean no heart-rate data was available.

calories_kcal.description: Calories in kilocalories, parsed from the activity's detail page during detail collection. Summary records carry null, and detail records may also have null.

gear.description: Gear name resolved from the activity's gear ID and the owner's bike and shoe lists during detail collection. Summary records carry null; detail records also use null when there is no gear ID or its name cannot be resolved.

freshness.description: Always 'live' for this browser collector: records are read from the signed-in Strava website, not an account-export archive. This identifies the collection method, not a promise of continuous refresh.

exported_at.description: Always null for this browser collector. It does not read an account-export archive or supply an archive generation timestamp.

reason_display_messages.covered_in_full: All Strava activities in the selected date range have already been collected.
reason_display_messages.collection_interrupted: Strava stopped answering partway through, so some activities are missing. The next run continues from where this one stopped.
reason_display_messages.nothing_in_range: Strava has no activities in the selected date range.
reason_display_messages.records_unreadable: Some activities in your Strava list couldn't be read and were skipped — everything else was collected normally.
reason_display_messages.sign_in_required: Strava needs you to sign in again before this can continue.
reason_display_messages.source_limit_reached: This run reached a source limit. The next run will retry the remaining activity work.
reason_display_messages.source_unreadable: Strava answered with a page this connector doesn't recognise, so nothing more was read. Strava may have changed its site — please report this rather than retrying.

pageshim.exception: Preserves the app's activities payload and STATE shape.
pageshim.login_message: Sign in to Strava, then return here.
